title: The second condition of Salah – Wudu
intro: Wudu is washing parts of the body so we can pray and read the Qur’an.

learn.html: The second condition of Salah is wudu – or, if needed, ghusl, or in need tayammum. Wudu is the religious washing of certain parts of the body for Salah, reciting the Qur’an and other worship.
We start wudu with A‘udhu billah, Bismillah and the niyyah:

learn.label: The niyyah of wudu
learn.ar: نَوَيْتُ أَنْ أَتَوَضَّأَ لِأَجْلِ الصَّلَاةِ وَلِرَفْعِ الْحَدَثِ تَقَرُّبًا إِلَى اللَّهِ تَعَالَى
learn.tr: Nawaytu an atawadda’a li-ajlis-salaati wa li-raf‘il-hadathi taqarruban ilallaahi ta‘aalaa.
learn.en: I intend to make wudu for Salah, to remove impurity and to come closer to Allah, the Most High.

learn.text: We make wudu with clean water:

items.label: 1. Wash the hands past the wrists three times
2. Rinse the mouth with the right hand three times, and brush the teeth (or use a miswak)
5. Wash the right arm past the elbow three times
6. Wash the left arm past the elbow three times
7. Wipe at least a quarter of the head with a wet hand – mash
8. Wipe the ears inside and out
9. Wipe the neck once with the back of the fingers
10. Wash the right and left foot past the ankles

learn.title: Hadith
learn.html: Muhammad (SAW) said: “Allah does not accept the prayer of anyone until he makes wudu properly.” (Abu Dawud)
After wudu it is lovely to say the Shahadah.

practice.title: Wudu in order
practice.prompt: Put the steps of wudu in order.
